en-US.description: See and use previous text copied in the clipboard
en-US.longDescription:
Japplis Clipboard History - Show Text Clipboard History
Clipboard History is a freeware that remembers the text copied in the clipboard. You can see the list of previous copied text and put them back in the clipboard.
